title: How to Wash and Care for Block Printed Cotton Kurtis
excerpt: Simple tips to keep your block printed cotton kurtis and dresses bright and soft for years.
seo_title: How to Wash Block Printed Cotton Kurtis – Care Tips
seo_description: Easy care tips for block printed cotton kurtis and dresses: first wash, detergent, drying and ironing so colours stay bright.
body:
Hand block printed cotton uses natural and pigment colours. A little care keeps your kurti looking new for a long time.

## First wash

- Soak in cold water with a spoon of salt for 15 minutes
- Wash separately the first 2–3 times
- Some colour release in the first wash is normal for hand printed fabric

## Regular washing

- Cold water, mild liquid detergent
- Hand wash or gentle machine cycle
- Turn the garment inside out
- Do not use bleach

## Drying

Dry in shade, inside out. Strong sunlight can fade colours.

## Ironing

Iron on medium heat on the reverse side.

## Storage

Store folded in a cool, dry place. Use a cotton bag for festive pieces.
